answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> The Holy Quran Question ID: 8191 Country: India Title: Question: What is the minimum days requird one could recite Holy Qura'n in seclusion? Can someone read it in a days time as did Imaam Shaafi (RAH). Answer ID: 8191 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 2040/313=TB/1429) One should complete reciting the Holy Quran in at least three days or seven days. If one is able to recite the whole Quran with correct pronunciation then it is allowed to complete in one day. The Quran should be completed in maximum forty days. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
